title.sk: Käsespätzle – halušky so syrom a opraženou cibuľkou
title.en: Käsespätzle: cheese spätzle with crispy onions

description.sk: Mäkké vaječné halušky premiešané s roztopeným syrom a navrchu chrumkavá hnedá cibuľka.
description.en: Soft egg spätzle tossed with melted cheese and topped with crisp browned onions.

note.sk: alebo iný tvrdý syr, ktorý sa ťahá

steps.sk: Do misy daj múku, lyžičku soli a muškátový oriešok, pridaj vajcia a mlieko a vareškou vymiešaj husté, lepkavé cesto. Šľahaj ho 3 minúty, kým nezačne robiť bubliny – halušky potom budú nadýchané. Nechaj ho 10 minút odpočívať.
steps.en: Put the flour, a teaspoon of salt and the nutmeg in a bowl, add the eggs and milk and beat with a wooden spoon into a thick, sticky batter. Keep beating for 3 minutes until bubbles form, which makes the spätzle light. Rest it for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska a smaž ju na oleji s polovicou masla na strednom ohni 15 minút, kým nie je hnedá a chrumkavá. Prelož ju na papierovú utierku.
steps.en: Slice the onions thinly and fry them in the oil and half the butter over a medium heat for 15 minutes until brown and crisp. Drain them on kitchen paper.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnci priveď do varu vodu so zvyšnou soľou. Cesto pretláčaj cez strúhadlo na halušky alebo cez veľké otvory obyčajného strúhadla priamo do vody. Keď halušky vyplávajú, var ich ešte 1 minútu a vyber ich dierovanou lyžicou.
steps.en: Bring a large pot of water with the remaining salt to the boil. Press the batter through a spätzle maker or the large holes of a box grater straight into the water. Once the spätzle float, cook them for 1 more minute and lift them out with a slotted spoon.

steps.sk: Na širokej panvici rozpusti zvyšné maslo, pridaj halušky a postupne vmiešaj nastrúhaný syr a korenie. Miešaj na miernom ohni 2 až 3 minúty, kým sa syr neroztopí a nezačne sa ťahať.
steps.en: Melt the remaining butter in a wide pan, add the spätzle and gradually stir in the grated cheese and pepper. Stir over a low heat for 2 to 3 minutes until the cheese melts and turns stringy.

steps.sk: Podávaj posypané opraženou cibuľkou a pažítkou, so zeleným šalátom s octovým dresingom, ktorý vyváži bohatosť syra. Zvyšky prehreješ na panvici s lyžicou mlieka.
steps.en: Serve topped with the crisp onions and chives, with a green salad in a sharp vinaigrette to balance the rich cheese. Reheat leftovers in a pan with a spoonful of milk.

title.sk: Bigos – poľský kapustový guláš s mäsom
title.en: Bigos: Polish hunter's stew

description.sk: Dlho dusená kyslá aj čerstvá kapusta s bravčovým, klobásou, slaninou a hubami.
description.en: Sauerkraut and fresh cabbage slow-cooked with pork, sausage, bacon and mushrooms.

steps.sk: Sušené huby namoč na 20 minút do 200 ml teplej vody. Kyslú kapustu vytlač a nahrubo posekaj, čerstvú nakrájaj na rezance. Mäso nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 2 cm, klobásu na kolieska a slaninu na drobné kocky.
steps.en: Soak the dried mushrooms in 200 ml warm water for 20 minutes. Squeeze the sauerkraut and chop it roughly; shred the fresh cabbage. Cut the pork into 2 cm cubes, the sausage into rounds and the bacon into small dice.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnci opraž slaninu 5 minút, kým nepustí tuk. Pridaj mäso a opekaj ho na silnom ohni v dvoch dávkach zo všetkých strán dohneda, potom pridaj nakrájanú cibuľu a klobásu a opekaj ďalších 5 minút.
steps.en: Fry the bacon in a large pot for 5 minutes until the fat runs. Add the pork and brown it on all sides over a high heat in two batches, then add the chopped onions and sausage and fry for another 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj paradajkový pretlak a papriku, prilej víno a nechaj ho 2 minúty povrieť. Pridaj obe kapusty, huby nakrájané na rezance aj s vodou (piesok na dne misky nechaj), bobkové listy, nové korenie, rascu, korenie, soľ a 300 ml vody.
steps.en: Stir in the tomato paste and paprika, pour in the wine and let it bubble for 2 minutes. Add both cabbages, the mushrooms cut into strips with their water (leave any grit in the bowl), the bay leaves, allspice, caraway, pepper, salt and 300 ml water.

steps.sk: Var prikryté na miernom ohni 2 hodiny a občas premiešaj až po dno; ak sa prichytáva, prilej trochu vody. Bigos je hotový, keď je kapusta mäkká a tmavšia a mäso sa rozpadá.
steps.en: Simmer, covered, over a low heat for 2 hours, stirring right to the bottom now and then; add a little water if it catches. Bigos is ready when the cabbage is soft and darker and the pork falls apart.

steps.sk: Ak máš slivkový lekvár, vmiešaj ho na konci pre jemnú sladkosť a ochutnaj. Podávaj s chlebom alebo zemiakmi. Bigos je najlepší na druhý či tretí deň – v chladničke vydrží 5 dní a dobre sa mrazí.
steps.en: If you have plum butter, stir it in at the end for a gentle sweetness, then taste. Serve with bread or potatoes. Bigos is best on the second or third day; it keeps in the fridge for 5 days and freezes well.

title.sk: Plnená kapusta na kyslej kapuste
title.en: Stuffed cabbage rolls on sauerkraut

description.sk: Kapustné listy plnené mäsom a ryžou, dusené na kyslej kapuste s paprikou a smotanou.
description.en: Cabbage leaves stuffed with pork and rice, braised on sauerkraut with paprika and sour cream.

steps.sk: Z kapusty vyrež hrubý koreň a celú hlávku ponor do veľkého hrnca vriacej vody. Po 2 až 3 minútach z nej opatrne odlupuj zmäknuté vonkajšie listy a pokračuj, kým nemáš 12 až 14 listov. Z listov zrež hrubú strednú žilu, aby sa dali zrolovať.
steps.en: Cut the core out of the cabbage and lower the whole head into a large pot of boiling water. After 2 to 3 minutes, carefully peel off the softened outer leaves and repeat until you have 12 to 14. Shave down the thick central rib of each leaf so it rolls easily.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni a var ju 8 minút v 200 ml vody, aby bola napoly mäkká, a nechaj vychladnúť. Jednu cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a speň ju na masti 4 minúty. Mäso zmiešaj s ryžou, cibuľou, vajcom, prelisovaným cesnakom, polovicou papriky, majoránom, soľou a korením.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and cook it in 200 ml water for 8 minutes until half done, then let it cool. Finely chop one onion and soften it in the lard for 4 minutes. Mix the pork with the rice, onion, egg, crushed garlic, half the paprika, the marjoram, salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Na každý list polož 2 lyžice plnky, prelož naň spodok listu a boky a pevne zroluj. Druhú cibuľu a slaninu nakrájaj nadrobno a opraž ich v širokom hrnci 5 minút, potom pridaj polovicu kyslej kapusty a zvyšné kapustné listy nakrájané na rezance.
steps.en: Put 2 tablespoons of filling on each leaf, fold over the base and sides and roll up tightly. Finely chop the second onion and the bacon and fry them in a wide pot for 5 minutes, then add half the sauerkraut and the leftover cabbage leaves, shredded.

steps.sk: Na kapustu poukladaj závitky spojom nadol a prikry ich zvyšnou kyslou kapustou a bobkovými listami. Zalej ich vodou s rozmiešaným pretlakom a zvyšnou paprikou tak, aby siahala tesne pod hornú vrstvu, prikry a var na miernom ohni 1,5 hodiny.
steps.en: Lay the rolls seam side down on the cabbage and cover with the remaining sauerkraut and the bay leaves. Pour over water mixed with the tomato paste and remaining paprika until it reaches just below the top layer, cover and simmer gently for 1½ hours.

steps.sk: Kyslú smotanu rozšľahaj s múkou a naberačkou šťavy, vlej ju medzi závitky a jemne potras hrncom, aby sa rozptýlila. Povar 5 minút. Plnka je hotová, keď má vnútri 70 °C a ryža je mäkká.
steps.en: Whisk the sour cream with the flour and a ladle of the cooking liquid, pour it between the rolls and gently shake the pot to spread it. Simmer for 5 minutes. The filling is done when it reaches 70 °C inside and the rice is soft.

steps.sk: Podávaj dva závitky s kapustou a lyžicou šťavy, s chlebom. Plnená kapusta je lepšia na druhý deň: v chladničke vydrží 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť aj so šťavou.
steps.en: Serve two rolls per person with the sauerkraut and a spoonful of the sauce, with bread. The rolls are even better the next day; they keep in the fridge for 4 days and freeze well in their sauce.

title.sk: Currywurst s pečenými hranolkami
title.en: Currywurst with oven fries

description.sk: Berlínska klasika: opečené párky v pikantnej kari omáčke z kečupu a chrumkavé hranolky z rúry.
description.en: A Berlin classic: seared frankfurters in a tangy curry ketchup with crisp oven fries.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na hranolky hrubé 1 cm a 10 minút ich namáčaj v studenej vode, aby pustili škrob. Potom ich dôkladne osuš utierkou – mokré by sa dusili, nie piekli.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Peel the potatoes, cut them into 1 cm fries and soak them in cold water for 10 minutes to wash off the starch. Dry them thoroughly with a tea towel; wet fries steam instead of crisping.

steps.sk: Hranolky premiešaj s 1,5 lyžicou oleja a soľou, rozlož ich v jednej vrstve na plech s papierom na pečenie a peč 30 až 35 minút, v polovici ich obráť. Hotové sú zlatisté a chrumkavé.
steps.en: Toss the fries with 1½ tablespoons of oil and the salt, spread them in a single layer on a lined baking tray and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, turning halfway. They are done when golden and crisp.

steps.sk: Medzitým priprav omáčku: cibuľu nastrúhaj najemno a speň ju na zvyšnom oleji 3 minúty. Pridaj kari, obe papriky a pretlak a miešaj 30 sekúnd, potom vmiešaj kečup, cukor, ocot a 50 ml vody a var 5 minút do hustej, lesklej omáčky.
steps.en: Meanwhile, make the sauce: finely grate the onion and soften it in the remaining oil for 3 minutes. Add the curry powder, both paprikas and the tomato paste and stir for 30 seconds, then add the ketchup, sugar, vinegar and 50 ml water and simmer for 5 minutes into a thick, glossy sauce.

steps.sk: Párky zľahka narež do mriežky a opeč ich na suchej panvici zo všetkých strán 5 minút, kým sa zárezy neroztvoria a nezhnednú. Nakrájaj ich na kolieska hrubé 1,5 cm.
steps.en: Lightly score the frankfurters in a criss-cross and sear them in a dry frying pan on all sides for 5 minutes until the cuts open up and brown. Slice them into 1.5 cm rounds.

steps.sk: Párky polož na tanier, prelej ich horúcou omáčkou a posyp štipkou kari. Podávaj s hranolkami ako v berlínskych stánkoch. Zvyšná omáčka vydrží v chladničke týždeň.
steps.en: Pile the frankfurters on a plate, pour over the hot sauce and dust with a pinch of curry powder. Serve with the fries, as at a Berlin street stall. Leftover sauce keeps in the fridge for a week.

title.sk: Alpské makaróny so zemiakmi a syrom
title.en: Älplermagronen: alpine pasta with potatoes and cheese

description.sk: Švajčiarske horské jedlo: cestoviny so zemiakmi v syrovej smotane, cibuľka a jablkové pyré.
description.en: A Swiss mountain dish of pasta and potatoes in cheesy cream, with fried onions and apple sauce.

steps.sk: Jablká ošúp, zbav jadrovníkov a nakrájaj na kúsky. Daj ich do malého hrnca s cukrom, citrónovou šťavou, štipkou škorice a 3 lyžicami vody a var prikryté 10 minút, kým sa nerozpadnú. Roztlač ich na pyré a nechaj vychladnúť.
steps.en: Peel, core and chop the apples. Put them in a small pan with the sugar, lemon juice, a pinch of cinnamon and 3 tablespoons of water and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes until they collapse. Mash them to a purée and leave to cool.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 1,5 cm a daj ich variť do veľkého hrnca vody s ½ lyžičkou soli. Po 5 minútach pridaj cestoviny a var spolu podľa času na obale cestovín, kým nie je všetko mäkké.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, cut them into 1.5 cm cubes and put them on to boil in a large pot of water with ½ teaspoon of salt. After 5 minutes add the pasta and cook together for the time on the pasta packet, until everything is tender.

steps.sk: Medzitým nakrájaj cibuľu na tenké polkolieska a smaž ju na masle na strednom ohni 12 minút, kým nie je zlatohnedá a chrumkavá.
steps.en: Meanwhile, slice the onions thinly and fry them in the butter over a medium heat for 12 minutes until golden brown and crisp.

steps.sk: Zemiaky s cestovinami sceď a vráť do hrnca. Prilej smotanu a mlieko, pridaj nastrúhaný syr, muškátový oriešok, zvyšnú soľ a korenie a miešaj na miernom ohni 2 minúty, kým syr nevytvorí krémovú omáčku.
steps.en: Drain the potatoes and pasta and return them to the pot. Pour in the cream and milk, add the grated cheese, nutmeg, remaining salt and pepper and stir over a low heat for 2 minutes until the cheese forms a creamy sauce.

steps.sk: Podávaj posypané cibuľkou, s vychladeným jablkovým pyré na boku – jeho kyslastá sladkosť patrí k tomuto jedlu rovnako ako syr. Zvyšky prehreješ s trochou mlieka.
steps.en: Serve topped with the onions, with the cool apple sauce on the side; its tangy sweetness belongs to this dish as much as the cheese does. Reheat leftovers with a splash of milk.

title.sk: Kapustové fliačky s karamelizovanou kapustou
title.en: Krautfleckerl: pasta with caramelised cabbage

description.sk: Lacné rakúsko-slovenské jedlo z cestovín a pomaly opekanej sladkastej kapusty s rascou.
description.en: A frugal Austrian and Slovak dish of pasta with slowly browned, sweetish cabbage and caraway.

note.en: pasta squares or other short pasta

steps.sk: Kapustu zbav vonkajších listov a hrubého koreňa a nakrájaj ju na štvorčeky s hranou 1,5 cm, cibuľu nadrobno. Kapustu premiešaj s lyžičkou soli, nechaj 15 minút odstáť a potom ju vytlač – rýchlejšie potom zhnedne.
steps.en: Remove the outer leaves and tough core of the cabbage and cut it into 1.5 cm squares; chop the onions finely. Toss the cabbage with a teaspoon of salt, leave it for 15 minutes, then squeeze it out so it browns faster.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici rozohrej olej, pridaj cukor a nechaj ho na strednom ohni roztopiť do svetlého karamelu. Pridaj cibuľu a smaž ju 3 minúty.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pan, add the sugar and let it melt over a medium heat into a pale caramel. Add the onions and fry for 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj kapustu a rascu a opekaj za častého miešania 20 až 25 minút, kým kapusta nezmäkne a nezíska zlatohnedú farbu. Ak sa prichytáva, prilej 2 lyžice vody – nemá sa dusiť, ale pomaly opekať.
steps.en: Add the cabbage and caraway and fry, stirring often, for 20 to 25 minutes until the cabbage is soft and golden brown. If it catches, add 2 tablespoons of water; it should slowly fry, not stew.

steps.sk: Medzitým uvar cestoviny vo vode so zvyšnou soľou podľa návodu na obale a sceď ich.
steps.en: Meanwhile, cook the pasta in water with the remaining salt as the packet directs and drain it well.

steps.sk: Cestoviny premiešaj s kapustou, okoreň, pokvapkaj octom a opekaj ešte 2 minúty, aby sa chute spojili. Podávaj samotné alebo so šalátom; vydržia v chladničke 3 dni a prehreješ ich na panvici.
steps.en: Toss the pasta with the cabbage, season with pepper, sprinkle with the vinegar and fry for 2 more minutes to bring it together. Serve on its own or with a salad; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days and reheats in a frying pan.

title.sk: Tirolské syrové knedlíčky vo vývare
title.en: Kaspressknödel: Tyrolean cheese dumplings in broth

description.sk: Opečené placky z rožkov, vajec a syra podávané v horúcom zeleninovom vývare.
description.en: Pan-fried patties of bread, egg and cheese served in hot vegetable broth.

steps.sk: Rožky nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 1 cm. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a speň ju na masle 4 minúty do sklovita. Syr nastrúhaj na hrubom strúhadle.
steps.en: Cut the rolls into 1 cm cubes. Finely chop the onion and soften it in the butter for 4 minutes until translucent. Coarsely grate the cheese.

steps.sk: Mlieko rozšľahaj s vajcami, muškátovým orieškom, štipkou soli a korením a prelej ním rožky. Pridaj cibuľu, syr, petržlenovú vňať a polovicu pažítky, rukami premiešaj a nechaj 15 minút postáť, kým rožky nenasajú tekutinu.
steps.en: Whisk the milk with the eggs, nutmeg, a pinch of salt and the pepper and pour it over the bread. Add the onion, cheese, parsley and half the chives, mix with your hands and leave for 15 minutes until the bread soaks up the liquid.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj múku a mokrými rukami vytvaruj 8 guliek, ktoré stlač na placky hrubé 2 cm. Ak sa rozpadajú, pridaj lyžicu múky, ak sú suché, trochu mlieka.
steps.en: Mix in the flour and, with wet hands, shape 8 balls, then flatten them into 2 cm thick patties. If they fall apart, add a spoonful of flour; if they are dry, a splash of milk.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej olej na strednom ohni a placky opekaj 3 až 4 minúty z každej strany dozlatista, kým sa syr vnútri neroztopí. Medzitým var 1,2 litra vody s bujónom a mrkvou nakrájanou na tenké kolieska 10 minút.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and fry the patties for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until golden and the cheese inside has melted. Meanwhile, simmer 1.2 litres of water with the stock cube and thinly sliced carrot for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Knedlíčky daj do hlbokých tanierov, zalej ich horúcim vývarom s mrkvou a posyp zvyšnou pažítkou. Podávaj hneď, kým sú zvonka chrumkavé. Opečené vydržia 2 dni v chladničke a prehreješ ich priamo vo vývare.
steps.en: Put the dumplings in deep bowls, ladle over the hot broth with the carrot and sprinkle with the rest of the chives. Serve straight away while they are still crisp outside. Fried dumplings keep for 2 days in the fridge and reheat right in the broth.

title.sk: Boršč s hovädzím mäsom a kyslou smotanou
title.en: Borscht with beef and sour cream

description.sk: Sýto červená cviklová polievka s kapustou, zemiakmi a mäkkým hovädzím, so smotanou a kôprom.
description.en: A deep red beetroot soup with cabbage, potatoes and tender beef, finished with sour cream and dill.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 3 cm, vlož ho do veľkého hrnca s 2,5 litra studenej vody, bobkovými listami, novým korením a lyžičkou soli a priveď do varu. Zober penu, ktorá vypláva, a var na miernom ohni prikryté 1 hodinu.
steps.en: Cut the beef into 3 cm cubes, put it in a large pot with 2.5 litres of cold water, the bay leaves, allspice and a teaspoon of salt and bring to the boil. Skim off the foam that rises and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 1 hour.

steps.sk: Medzitým ošúp cviklu a mrkvu a nastrúhaj ich na hrubom strúhadle, cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno, kapustu na tenké rezance a zemiaky na kocky s hranou 2 cm. Pri cvikle použi rukavice, silno farbí.
steps.en: Meanwhile, peel and coarsely grate the beetroot and carrot, chop the onion finely, shred the cabbage and cut the potatoes into 2 cm cubes. Wear gloves for the beetroot, as it stains.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej olej, speň cibuľu s mrkvou 5 minút, pridaj cviklu, pretlak, ocot a cukor a nechaj prikryté dusiť 10 minút. Ocot zachová cvikle sýtu červenú farbu, bez neho by polievka zhnedla.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan, soften the onion and carrot for 5 minutes, then add the beetroot, tomato paste, vinegar and sugar and stew, covered, for 10 minutes. The vinegar keeps the beetroot a vivid red; without it the soup turns brown.

steps.sk: Do vývaru s mäsom pridaj zemiaky a kapustu a var 15 minút. Potom vmiešaj cviklovú zmes a var ešte 10 minút, kým nie je všetko mäkké a mäso sa rozpadá pod vidličkou.
steps.en: Add the potatoes and cabbage to the beef broth and simmer for 15 minutes. Then stir in the beetroot mixture and simmer for 10 minutes more, until everything is tender and the beef breaks apart under a fork.

steps.sk: Pridaj prelisovaný cesnak, zvyšnú soľ a korenie a dochuť octom a cukrom tak, aby bola polievka jemne sladkokyslá. Odstav ju a nechaj 10 minút prikrytú odpočívať, chute sa spoja.
steps.en: Add the crushed garlic, the remaining salt and the pepper and balance with vinegar and sugar until gently sweet and sour. Take it off the heat and let it rest, covered, for 10 minutes so the flavours come together.

steps.sk: Podávaj s lyžicou kyslej smotany, posypaný kôprom a s tmavým chlebom. Boršč je ešte lepší na druhý deň; v chladničke vydrží 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Serve with a spoonful of sour cream, a scattering of dill and dark bread. Borscht is even better the next day; it keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes well.

title.sk: Hovädzie stroganov s hubami
title.en: Beef stroganoff with mushrooms

description.sk: Prúžky rýchlo opečenej hovädzej sviečkovice v omáčke z húb, kyslej smotany a horčice.
description.en: Strips of quickly seared beef in a sauce of mushrooms, sour cream and mustard.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni a var s 500 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 15 minút. Mäso nakrájaj naprieč vláknami na prúžky hrubé 1 cm a dlhé 5 cm, osuš ich a posyp mletou paprikou a korením.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and cook it with 500 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 15 minutes. Cut the beef across the grain into strips 1 cm thick and 5 cm long, pat them dry and season with the paprika and pepper.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozohrej olej na najsilnejšom ohni a mäso opekaj v dvoch dávkach vždy len 1 až 2 minúty, kým zvonka nezhnedne a vnútri zostane ružové. Veľa mäsa naraz by pustilo šťavu a dusilo sa. Prelož ho na tanier.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over the highest heat and sear the beef in two batches for just 1 to 2 minutes each, until browned outside and still pink within. Too much meat at once releases its juices and stews. Set it aside on a plate.

steps.sk: Zníž oheň na stredný, rozpusti maslo a opekaj na ňom nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 3 minúty, potom pridaj huby na plátkoch a opekaj 6 minút, kým nezhnednú.
steps.en: Lower the heat to medium, melt the butter and fry the finely chopped onion for 3 minutes, then add the sliced mushrooms and fry for 6 minutes until browned.

steps.sk: Huby popráš múkou, prilej 200 ml vody s rozdrobeným bujónom a povar 3 minúty. Odstav panvicu, vmiešaj kyslú smotanu s horčicou a vráť mäso aj so šťavou. Prehrej ho 1 minútu na miernom ohni, ale nevar – smotana by sa zrazila a mäso stvrdlo.
steps.en: Dust the mushrooms with the flour, add 200 ml water with the crumbled stock cube and simmer for 3 minutes. Take the pan off the heat, stir in the sour cream and mustard and return the beef with its juices. Warm through over a low heat for 1 minute without boiling, or the cream splits and the beef toughens.

steps.sk: Dochuť soľou, posyp petržlenovou vňaťou a podávaj s ryžou alebo zemiakovou kašou. Stroganov je najlepší čerstvý; v chladničke vydrží 2 dni a prehrievaj ho len jemne.
steps.en: Season with salt, scatter with parsley and serve with rice or mashed potatoes. Stroganoff is best fresh; it keeps in the fridge for 2 days and should only be gently reheated.

title.sk: Hovädzie na červenom víne (boeuf bourguignon)
title.en: Boeuf bourguignon: beef braised in red wine

description.sk: Burgundská klasika: hovädzie pomaly dusené vo víne so slaninou, šalotkou a hubami.
description.en: The Burgundy classic: beef slowly braised in wine with bacon, shallots and mushrooms.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 160 °C. Mäso nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 4 cm, osuš ho papierovou utierkou a posoľ lyžičkou soli. Slaninu nakrájaj na prúžky, mrkvu na hrubé kolieska a cibuľu na kocky; šalotky ošúp a nechaj celé.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 160 °C. Cut the beef into 4 cm cubes, pat dry with kitchen paper and season with a teaspoon of salt. Cut the bacon into strips, the carrots into thick rounds and the onion into chunks; peel the shallots and leave them whole.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci vhodnom do rúry opraž slaninu na oleji 5 minút a vyber ju. Na tuku opekaj mäso v troch dávkach na silnom ohni, kým nemá zo všetkých strán tmavohnedú kôrku – tá dá omáčke hĺbku. Opečené mäso odkladaj k slanine.
steps.en: In a wide ovenproof pot, fry the bacon in the oil for 5 minutes and lift it out. Brown the beef in the fat in three batches over a high heat until it has a dark crust on all sides, which gives the sauce its depth. Set the browned meat aside with the bacon.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom tuku opeč cibuľu s mrkvou 5 minút, pridaj cesnak a pretlak, vráť mäso so slaninou, posyp ho múkou a premiešaj. Prilej víno a 300 ml vody s rozdrobeným bujónom, pridaj tymian a bobkové listy a priveď do varu.
steps.en: Fry the onion and carrots in the remaining fat for 5 minutes, add the garlic and tomato paste, return the beef and bacon, sprinkle with the flour and stir. Pour in the wine and 300 ml water with the crumbled stock cube, add the thyme and bay leaves and bring to the boil.

steps.sk: Hrniec prikry a vlož do rúry na 2,5 hodiny. Mäso je hotové, keď sa dá rozdeliť lyžicou a omáčka je hustá a lesklá; ak je riedka, posledných 20 minút ho nechaj odkryté.
steps.en: Cover the pot and put it in the oven for 2½ hours. The beef is done when it breaks apart with a spoon and the sauce is thick and glossy; if it is thin, uncover it for the last 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Pol hodiny pred koncom opeč na masle šalotky 8 minút dozlatista, pridaj huby nakrájané na štvrtinky a opekaj ďalších 5 minút. Zemiaky ošúp a uvar v osolenej vode (¼ lyžičky soli) 20 minút do mäkka.
steps.en: Half an hour before the end, fry the shallots in the butter for 8 minutes until golden, add the quartered mushrooms and fry for another 5 minutes. Peel the potatoes and boil them in salted water (¼ teaspoon of salt) for 20 minutes until tender.

steps.sk: Šalotky s hubami vmiešaj do mäsa, dochuť zvyšnou soľou a korením a posyp petržlenovou vňaťou. Podávaj so zemiakmi alebo bagetou. Na druhý deň je ešte lepšie; v chladničke vydrží 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Stir the shallots and mushrooms into the beef, season with the remaining salt and the pepper and scatter with parsley. Serve with the potatoes or a baguette. It is even better the next day, keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes well.

title.sk: Kuracie stehná na víne s hubami (coq au vin)
title.en: Coq au vin: chicken thighs in red wine with mushrooms

description.sk: Kuracie stehná dusené v červenom víne so slaninou, šalotkami a hubami.
description.en: Chicken thighs braised in red wine with bacon, shallots and mushrooms.

steps.sk: Stehná osuš, posoľ ich soľou a okoreň. Slaninu nakrájaj na prúžky, šalotky ošúp a rozpoľ, mrkvu nakrájaj na kolieska a huby na štvrtinky.
steps.en: Pat the thighs dry and season them with the salt and pepper. Cut the bacon into strips, peel and halve the shallots, slice the carrot into rounds and quarter the mushrooms.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci opraž slaninu 5 minút a vyber ju. Na jej tuku opeč stehná na stredne silnom ohni 6 minút, kým nie sú zlatohnedé, otoč ich na 2 minúty a tiež vyber.
steps.en: Fry the bacon in a wide pot for 5 minutes and lift it out. Brown the thighs in its fat over a medium-high heat for 6 minutes until golden, turn them for 2 minutes and lift them out too.

steps.sk: Na tom istom tuku opeč šalotky, mrkvu a huby 5 minút, pridaj cesnak a pretlak, posyp múkou a minútu miešaj. Prilej víno, vareškou zoškrab všetko, čo sa prichytilo na dno, a nechaj 2 minúty povrieť.
steps.en: In the same fat, fry the shallots, carrot and mushrooms for 5 minutes, add the garlic and tomato paste, sprinkle over the flour and stir for a minute. Pour in the wine, scrape up everything stuck to the bottom with a wooden spoon and let it bubble for 2 minutes.

steps.sk: Vráť mäso so slaninou, pridaj tymian, bobkové listy a 100 ml vody, prikry a var na miernom ohni 40 minút. Mäso je hotové, keď je mäkké a vnútri má aspoň 74 °C; omáčka má obaľovať lyžicu.
steps.en: Return the chicken and bacon, add the thyme, bay leaves and 100 ml water, cover and simmer gently for 40 minutes. The chicken is done when tender and at least 74 °C inside; the sauce should coat a spoon.

steps.sk: Ak je omáčka riedka, vyber mäso a omáčku 5 minút povar bez pokrievky, nakoniec do nej vmiešaj maslo pre lesk. Posyp petržlenovou vňaťou a podávaj so zemiakmi alebo s chlebom. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: If the sauce is thin, lift out the chicken and boil the sauce uncovered for 5 minutes, then stir in the butter for gloss. Scatter with parsley and serve with potatoes or bread. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Kuracie stehná po baskicky s paprikami
title.en: Poulet basquaise: chicken with peppers and tomatoes

description.sk: Šťavnaté stehná dusené s paprikami, paradajkami, šunkou a údenou paprikou, s ryžou.
description.en: Juicy thighs braised with peppers, tomatoes, ham and smoked paprika, with rice.

steps.sk: Stehná posoľ polovicou soli a okoreň. Papriky zbav jadrovníkov a nakrájaj na prúžky, cibuľu na polkolieska, cesnak na plátky a šunku na prúžky.
steps.en: Season the thighs with half the salt and the pepper. Core the peppers and cut them into strips; slice the onions into half-moons, the garlic thinly and the ham into strips.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici s vysokým okrajom rozohrej olej a stehná na ňom opeč 5 minút z každej strany dozlatista. Vyber ich na tanier.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a deep, wide frying pan and brown the thighs for 5 minutes on each side until golden. Set them aside on a plate.

steps.sk: Na výpeku opekaj cibuľu, papriky a šunku 8 minút, kým papriky nezmäknú. Pridaj cesnak, údenú papriku a čili, po 30 sekundách prilej víno a nechaj ho 1 minútu povrieť.
steps.en: In the pan juices, fry the onions, peppers and ham for 8 minutes until the peppers soften. Add the garlic, smoked paprika and chilli, then after 30 seconds pour in the wine and let it bubble for 1 minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, tymian, bobkový list a zvyšnú soľ, vráť stehná do omáčky, prikry a var na miernom ohni 25 minút. Medzitým uvar ryžu s 500 ml vody a štipkou soli 15 minút. Mäso je hotové pri 74 °C, keď je mäkké a šťava z neho je číra.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, thyme, bay leaf and remaining salt, nestle the thighs back into the sauce, cover and simmer gently for 25 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the rice with 500 ml water and a pinch of salt for 15 minutes. The chicken is done at 74 °C, tender with clear juices.

steps.sk: Podávaj stehná s paprikovou omáčkou na ryži. Jedlo je ideálne na prípravu dopredu: v krabičkách vydrží 3 dni a omáčka cez noc ešte zhustne.
steps.en: Serve the thighs and pepper sauce over the rice. It is ideal for cooking ahead: it keeps in boxes for 3 days and the sauce thickens further overnight.

title.sk: Cassoulet – zapekaná fazuľa s klobásou a kuracím
title.en: Cassoulet: baked white beans with sausage and chicken

description.sk: Výdatné juhofrancúzske jedlo z bielej fazule, klobásy a kuracích stehien pod chrumkavou kôrkou.
description.en: A hearty southern French dish of white beans, sausage and chicken thighs under a crisp crust.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 170 °C. Fazuľu sceď a prepláchni. Stehná prekroj na polovice, klobásu nakrájaj na hrubé kolieska, slaninu na kocky, cibuľu nadrobno a mrkvu na kolieska.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 170 °C. Drain and rinse the beans. Halve the thighs, cut the sausage into thick rounds and the bacon into cubes, chop the onions finely and slice the carrots.

steps.sk: V hrnci vhodnom do rúry opraž slaninu na oleji 4 minúty, pridaj stehná a klobásu a opekaj 8 minút, kým nezhnednú. Pridaj cibuľu, mrkvu a polovicu cesnaku nasekaného nadrobno a opekaj ďalšie 4 minúty.
steps.en: In an ovenproof pot, fry the bacon in the oil for 4 minutes, then add the thighs and sausage and fry for 8 minutes until browned. Add the onions, carrots and half the garlic, finely chopped, and fry for another 4 minutes.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj pretlak, paradajky, fazuľu, tymian, bobkové listy a 400 ml vody s rozdrobeným bujónom, osoľ, okoreň a priveď do varu. Fazuľa má byť takmer ponorená; ak treba, dolej vodu.
steps.en: Stir in the tomato paste, tomatoes, beans, thyme, bay leaves and 400 ml water with the crumbled stock cube, season with salt and pepper and bring to the boil. The beans should be almost covered; add water if needed.

steps.sk: Strúhanku zmiešaj s nasekanou petržlenovou vňaťou a zvyšným nadrobno nasekaným cesnakom a rovnomerne ňou posyp povrch. Hrniec vlož odkrytý do rúry na 1 hodinu a 15 minút.
steps.en: Mix the breadcrumbs with the chopped parsley and the rest of the garlic, finely chopped, and scatter it evenly over the top. Put the pot in the oven uncovered for 1 hour 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Po 40 minútach kôrku lyžicou jemne ponor do šťavy, aby nasala chuť, a nechaj ju vytvoriť znova. Hotový cassoulet je hustý, bublajúci a navrchu zlatý a kuracie má vnútri aspoň 74 °C.
steps.en: After 40 minutes, gently push the crust under the juices with a spoon so it soaks up the flavour, then let it form again. The cassoulet is ready when thick, bubbling and golden on top, with the chicken at least 74 °C inside.

steps.sk: Nechaj ho 10 minút odpočinúť a podávaj so zeleným šalátom. Zvyšky vydržia v chladničke 4 dni a dajú sa zamraziť; pri ohrievaní prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Let it rest for 10 minutes and serve with a green salad. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 4 days and freeze well; add a splash of water when reheating.

title.sk: Šošovica s klobásou po lyonsky
title.en: Lyon-style lentils with sausages

description.sk: Šošovica s koreňovou zeleninou a klobásami, dochutená horčicovým octovým dresingom.
description.en: Lentils with root vegetables and sausages, finished with a mustard vinaigrette.

steps.sk: Šošovicu prepláchni a prezri, či v nej nie sú kamienky. Cibuľu, mrkvu a zeler nakrájaj na drobné kocky a cesnak nadrobno.
steps.en: Rinse the lentils and pick them over for small stones. Dice the onion, carrots and celery small and chop the garlic finely.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozohrej polovicu oleja a celé klobásy na ňom opeč 6 minút zo všetkých strán dohneda. Vyber ich, na výpeku speň zeleninu 5 minút a pridaj cesnak.
steps.en: Heat half the oil in a pot and brown the whole sausages on all sides for 6 minutes. Lift them out, soften the vegetables in the fat for 5 minutes and add the garlic.

steps.sk: Pridaj šošovicu, bobkové listy, tymian a 900 ml vody a priveď do varu. Klobásy polož navrch, prikry a var na miernom ohni 25 až 30 minút, kým šošovica nie je mäkká, ale drží tvar. Soľ pridaj až na konci, inak by šošovica zostala tvrdá.
steps.en: Add the lentils, bay leaves, thyme and 900 ml water and bring to the boil. Lay the sausages on top, cover and simmer gently for 25 to 30 minutes until the lentils are tender but holding their shape. Add salt only at the end, or the lentils stay hard.

steps.sk: Horčicu rozšľahaj s octom, zvyšným olejom, soľou a korením a vmiešaj ju do šošovice spolu s petržlenovou vňaťou. Klobásy nakrájaj na hrubé kolieska.
steps.en: Whisk the mustard with the vinegar, the remaining oil, salt and pepper and stir it into the lentils with the parsley. Cut the sausages into thick slices.

steps.sk: Podávaj šošovicu s klobásami a kúskom chleba. Vďaka octovému dresingu chutí aj vlažná; v krabičkách vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Serve the lentils with the sausages and a piece of bread. Thanks to the vinaigrette it is good lukewarm too; it keeps in boxes for 4 days.

title.sk: Steak s omáčkou z čierneho korenia a hranolkami
title.en: Steak au poivre with oven fries

description.sk: Steak v kôrke z drveného korenia so smotanovou omáčkou z výpeku a chrumkavé hranolky z rúry.
description.en: Pepper-crusted steak with a creamy pan sauce and crisp oven fries.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Zemiaky nakrájaj na hranolky hrubé 1 cm, namoč ich na 10 minút do studenej vody a osuš. Premiešaj ich s lyžicou oleja a polovicou soli a peč na plechu s papierom 30 až 35 minút, v polovici ich obráť.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the potatoes into 1 cm fries, soak them in cold water for 10 minutes and dry them. Toss with a tablespoon of oil and half the salt and bake on a lined tray for 30 to 35 minutes, turning halfway.

steps.sk: Steaky vyber z chladničky 30 minút vopred. Korenie nahrubo podrv v mažiari alebo dnom panvice a vtlač ho do oboch strán mäsa. Osoľ ich zvyšnou soľou až tesne pred opečením.
steps.en: Take the steaks out of the fridge 30 minutes ahead. Coarsely crush the peppercorns in a mortar or with the base of a pan and press them into both sides of the meat. Salt them with the rest of the salt just before cooking.

steps.sk: Hrubú panvicu rozohrej so zvyšným olejom na najsilnejšom ohni, kým sa z oleja nezačne dymiť. Steaky opekaj 3 minúty z každej strany na medium (vnútri 55 až 57 °C), potom pridaj polovicu masla a 1 minútu ich ním polievaj.
steps.en: Heat a heavy frying pan with the remaining oil over the highest heat until the oil starts to smoke. Sear the steaks for 3 minutes on each side for medium (55 to 57 °C inside), then add half the butter and baste them with it for 1 minute.

steps.sk: Steaky prelož na teplý tanier a nechaj ich 5 minút odpočívať, aby sa v nich rozložila šťava. Na panvici zníž oheň, speň nadrobno nakrájanú šalotku na zvyšnom masle 1 minútu, prilej víno a vareškou zoškrab výpek.
steps.en: Move the steaks to a warm plate and rest them for 5 minutes so the juices settle. Lower the heat, soften the finely chopped shallot in the remaining butter for 1 minute, pour in the wine and scrape up the pan juices with a wooden spoon.

steps.sk: Keď víno takmer vyvrie, pridaj smotanu a horčicu a var 2 minúty, kým omáčka nezhustne a neobaľuje lyžicu. Prilej do nej šťavu, ktorá vytiekla zo steakov, a podávaj ju na mäse s hranolkami.
steps.en: When the wine has almost boiled away, add the cream and mustard and simmer for 2 minutes until the sauce thickens enough to coat a spoon. Stir in the juices from the resting steaks and spoon the sauce over the meat, with the fries alongside.

title.sk: Losos pečený v papieri so zeleninou a citrónom
title.en: Salmon en papillote with vegetables and lemon

description.sk: Losos a zelenina dusené vo vlastnej šťave v balíčku z papiera na pečenie, s citrónom a kôprom.
description.en: Salmon and vegetables steamed in their own juices in a baking paper parcel with lemon and dill.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Cuketu a mrkvu nakrájaj škrabkou alebo nožom na tenké pásiky, rajčinky rozpoľ a cesnak nakrájaj na tenké plátky. Citrón nakrájaj na tenké kolieska.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the courgette and carrot into thin ribbons with a peeler or knife, halve the cherry tomatoes and slice the garlic thinly. Cut the lemon into thin rounds.

steps.sk: Priprav dva štvorce papiera na pečenie s hranou 35 cm. Do stredu každého daj polovicu zeleniny, posoľ ju a pokvapkaj olejom. Navrch polož losos kožou nadol, posoľ ho, okoreň a oblož cesnakom, kôprom a kolieskami citróna.
steps.en: Cut two 35 cm squares of baking paper. Pile half the vegetables in the middle of each, salt them and drizzle with oil. Lay a salmon fillet on top skin side down, season it and top with the garlic, dill and lemon slices.

steps.sk: Pokvapkaj všetko vínom, okraje papiera zlož k sebe a niekoľkokrát ich prehni, aby vznikol tesne uzavretý balíček – para v ňom rybu uvarí. Balíčky polož na plech a peč 15 až 18 minút.
steps.en: Sprinkle with the wine, bring the edges of the paper together and fold them over several times to make a tightly sealed parcel; the steam inside cooks the fish. Put the parcels on a baking tray and bake for 15 to 18 minutes.

steps.sk: Losos je hotový, keď sa na najhrubšom mieste ľahko oddeľuje na lupienky a je matne ružový. Ak chceš prílohu, zalej kuskus rovnakým objemom vriacej vody so štipkou soli a nechaj ho 5 minút prikrytý napučať.
steps.en: The salmon is done when it flakes easily at its thickest point and has turned opaque pink. For a side, pour an equal volume of boiling water with a pinch of salt over the couscous and leave it covered for 5 minutes to swell.

steps.sk: Balíčky podávaj rovno na tanieroch a otvor ich až pri stole, aby unikla vôňa citróna a kôpru. Šťavu z balíčka nalej na kuskus. Upečený losos zjedz ešte v ten deň.
steps.en: Serve the parcels on the plates and open them at the table to release the scent of lemon and dill. Pour the parcel juices over the couscous. Eat the cooked salmon the same day.

title.sk: Karfiolový gratin so syrovou omáčkou
title.en: Cauliflower gratin with cheese sauce

description.sk: Karfiol zapečený v syrovej besamelovej omáčke so zlatou chrumkavou kôrkou.
description.en: Cauliflower baked in a cheesy béchamel under a golden, crunchy crust.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Karfiol rozober na stredne veľké ružičky a var ich v osolenej vode (¼ lyžičky soli) 5 minút, aby len zmäkli na povrchu. Sceď ich a nechaj odpariť – mokrý karfiol by omáčku zriedil.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Break the cauliflower into medium florets and boil them in salted water (¼ teaspoon of salt) for 5 minutes, just to soften the outside. Drain and let them steam dry; wet cauliflower waters down the sauce.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozpusti maslo, vmiešaj múku a miešaj minútu na miernom ohni. Postupne prilievaj studené mlieko a stále šľahaj metličkou, aby nevznikli hrudky, a var 5 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne ako smotana.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a pan, stir in the flour and cook for a minute over a low heat. Gradually pour in the cold milk, whisking all the time to avoid lumps, and simmer for 5 minutes until the sauce is as thick as cream.

steps.sk: Omáčku odstav a vmiešaj do nej dve tretiny nastrúhaného syra, horčicu, muškátový oriešok, zvyšnú soľ a korenie. Karfiol rozlož do zapekacej misy a rovnomerne ho prelej omáčkou.
steps.en: Take the sauce off the heat and stir in two-thirds of the grated cheese, the mustard, nutmeg, remaining salt and pepper. Spread the cauliflower in a baking dish and pour the sauce evenly over it.

steps.sk: Zvyšný syr zmiešaj so strúhankou a posyp ním povrch. Zapekaj 20 až 25 minút, kým omáčka nebublá a povrch nie je zlatohnedý.
steps.en: Mix the rest of the cheese with the breadcrumbs and scatter over the top. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until the sauce is bubbling and the top is golden brown.

steps.sk: Nechaj ho 5 minút postáť a podávaj s chlebom alebo ako prílohu k mäsu. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni; prehrej ho v rúre, v mikrovlnke kôrka zmäkne.
steps.en: Let it stand for 5 minutes and serve with bread or as a side to meat. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days; reheat it in the oven, as the microwave softens the crust.

title.sk: Flammkuchen – alsaský koláč so smotanou, cibuľou a slaninou
title.en: Flammkuchen: Alsatian tart with cream, onion and bacon

description.sk: Tenučký chrumkavý plát cesta so smotanovým krémom, cibuľou a slaninou, hotový za 12 minút pečenia.
description.en: A wafer-thin, crisp base with a creamy topping, onion and bacon, baked in 12 minutes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na najvyššiu teplotu, ideálne 250 °C, aj s plechom vnútri. Múku zmiešaj s ½ lyžičky soli, olejom a 140 ml vlažnej vody a vymies hladké cesto bez droždia. Prikry ho a nechaj 15 minút odpočívať.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to its highest setting, ideally 250 °C, with a baking tray inside. Mix the flour with ½ teaspoon of salt, the oil and 140 ml lukewarm water and knead into a smooth, yeast-free dough. Cover and rest it for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na veľmi tenké polkolieska a slaninu na tenké prúžky. Kyslú smotanu rozmiešaj s tvarohom, zvyšnou soľou, korením a muškátovým orieškom dohladka.
steps.en: Slice the onions into very thin half-moons and the bacon into thin strips. Mix the sour cream with the quark, remaining salt, pepper and nutmeg until smooth.

steps.sk: Cesto rozdeľ na dve časti a každú rozvaľkaj na papieri na pečenie na tenučký plát hrubý 2 mm – má byť skoro priesvitný. Natri ho smotanovou zmesou takmer po okraj a rovnomerne posyp cibuľou a slaninou.
steps.en: Divide the dough in two and roll each piece out on baking paper into a sheet 2 mm thin, almost see-through. Spread it with the cream mixture almost to the edges and scatter evenly with the onion and bacon.

steps.sk: Papier s plackou presuň na rozpálený plech a peč 10 až 12 minút, kým okraje nie sú chrumkavé a miestami pripálené a slanina zlatistá. Druhú placku peč rovnako.
steps.en: Slide the paper and tart onto the hot tray and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the edges are crisp and charred in places and the bacon is golden. Bake the second tart the same way.

steps.sk: Posyp pažítkou, nakrájaj na obdĺžniky a podávaj hneď so zeleným šalátom. V Alsasku sa flammkuchen je rukami, kým je horúci a chrumkavý.
steps.en: Sprinkle with chives, cut into rectangles and serve at once with a green salad. In Alsace it is eaten with the hands while hot and crisp.

title.sk: Lyonský šalát so slaninou, krutónmi a vajcom
title.en: Salade lyonnaise with bacon, croutons and poached egg

description.sk: Chrumkavý šalát s teplým horčicovým dresingom, slaninou, opečeným chlebom a strateným vajcom.
description.en: A crisp salad with a warm mustard dressing, bacon, fried croutons and a poached egg.

steps.sk: Šalát umy, osuš v odstreďovači a natrhaj na kúsky. Chlieb nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 1,5 cm, slaninu na hrubé prúžky a šalotku nadrobno.
steps.en: Wash the lettuce, spin it dry and tear it into pieces. Cut the bread into 1.5 cm cubes, the bacon into thick strips and the shallot finely.

steps.sk: Slaninu opekaj na suchej panvici na strednom ohni 6 minút, kým nie je chrumkavá, a vyber ju. Na jej tuku s lyžicou oleja opeč kocky chleba za častého miešania 3 až 4 minúty dozlatista.
steps.en: Fry the bacon in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 6 minutes until crisp and lift it out. Fry the bread cubes in its fat with a tablespoon of oil, stirring often, for 3 to 4 minutes until golden.

steps.sk: Panvicu stiahni z ohňa, pridaj do nej šalotku, 2 lyžice octu, horčicu, zvyšný olej, soľ a korenie a rozmiešaj – teplý dresing šalát jemne zvädne.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat and add the shallot, 2 tablespoons of vinegar, the mustard, remaining oil, salt and pepper and stir; the warm dressing will gently wilt the leaves.

steps.sk: V malom hrnci priveď vodu so zvyšným octom do mierneho varu, lyžicou vytvor vír a vajcia doň opatrne vklzni. Var ich 3 minúty, kým bielok stuhne a žĺtok zostane tekutý, a vyber ich dierovanou lyžicou.
steps.en: Bring a small pan of water with the remaining vinegar to a gentle simmer, stir it into a whirlpool and carefully slide in the eggs. Poach them for 3 minutes until the whites set and the yolks stay runny, then lift them out with a slotted spoon.

steps.sk: Šalát premiešaj s teplým dresingom, slaninou a krutónmi, rozdeľ ho na taniere a na každý polož vajce. Pri jedle žĺtok prepichni, stane sa z neho druhý dresing. Podávaj hneď.
steps.en: Toss the leaves with the warm dressing, bacon and croutons, divide between plates and top each with an egg. Break the yolk as you eat; it becomes a second dressing. Serve straight away.

title.sk: Albóndigas – mäsové guľky v mandľovej omáčke
title.en: Albóndigas: Spanish meatballs in almond sauce

description.sk: Šťavnaté guľky z bravčového a hovädzieho dusené v omáčke z opražených mandlí, cesnaku a vína.
description.en: Juicy pork and beef meatballs simmered in a sauce of toasted almonds, garlic and wine.

note.sk: 40 g do mäsa, zvyšok na podávanie
note.en: 40 g for the meat, the rest to serve

steps.sk: 40 g chleba bez kôrky namoč do mlieka. Mäso zmiešaj s vyžmýkaným chlebom, vajcom, 2 prelisovanými strúčikmi cesnaku, polovicou petržlenovej vňate, ¾ lyžičky soli a korením. Mokrými rukami vytvaruj 20 guliek veľkých ako vlašský orech a obaľ ich v múke.
steps.en: Soak 40 g of crustless bread in the milk. Mix the meat with the squeezed bread, egg, 2 crushed garlic cloves, half the parsley, ¾ teaspoon of salt and the pepper. With wet hands, roll 20 walnut-sized balls and dust them in flour.

steps.sk: Na širokej panvici rozohrej olej a guľky opekaj na stredne silnom ohni 6 až 8 minút, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán zlatohnedé. Nemusia byť ešte prepečené, dovaria sa v omáčke. Vyber ich na tanier.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide frying pan and brown the meatballs over a medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes until golden all over. They need not be cooked through yet, as they finish in the sauce. Set them aside on a plate.

steps.sk: Na tom istom oleji opeč mandle so zvyšným cesnakom 2 minúty dozlatista a vyber ich. Pridaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu a speň ju 6 minút. Mandle s cesnakom rozdrv v mažiari alebo rozmixuj s 3 lyžicami vody na hrubú pastu.
steps.en: In the same oil, fry the almonds and remaining garlic for 2 minutes until golden and lift them out. Add the finely chopped onion and soften it for 6 minutes. Pound the almonds and garlic in a mortar, or blend them with 3 tablespoons of water, into a coarse paste.

steps.sk: K cibuli vmiešaj papriku, prilej víno a nechaj ho minútu povrieť. Pridaj 300 ml vody s rozdrobeným bujónom a mandľovú pastu, vráť guľky a var prikryté na miernom ohni 15 minút. Guľky sú hotové pri 70 °C, keď už nie sú vnútri ružové.
steps.en: Stir the paprika into the onion, pour in the wine and let it bubble for a minute. Add 300 ml water with the crumbled stock cube and the almond paste, return the meatballs and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 15 minutes. They are done at 70 °C, when no longer pink inside.

steps.sk: Posyp zvyšnou vňaťou, dochuť zvyšnou soľou a podávaj s chlebom na vytieranie omáčky, ako tapas alebo hlavné jedlo. V chladničke vydržia 3 dni a dajú sa zamraziť aj s omáčkou.
steps.en: Scatter with the remaining parsley, season with the rest of the salt and serve with bread to mop up the sauce, as tapas or a main course. They keep in the fridge for 3 days and freeze well in their sauce.

title.sk: Pisto manchego s volským okom
title.en: Pisto manchego: Spanish vegetable stew with a fried egg

description.sk: Pomaly dusená paprika, cuketa, cibuľa a paradajky na olivovom oleji, navrchu vajce.
description.en: Peppers, courgette, onion and tomatoes slowly stewed in olive oil, topped with an egg.

steps.sk: Cibuľu a papriky nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 1 cm, cuketu na rovnako veľké kocky a cesnak nadrobno. Zeleninu krájaj na rovnaké kúsky, aby bola hotová naraz.
steps.en: Cut the onions and peppers into 1 cm dice, the courgettes into dice of the same size and the garlic finely. Keep the pieces even so they cook at the same rate.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici rozohrej 3 lyžice oleja a na miernom ohni smaž cibuľu 8 minút, kým nie je mäkká a sladká. Pridaj papriky a cesnak a opekaj ďalších 10 minút za občasného miešania.
steps.en: Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a wide pan and cook the onions gently for 8 minutes until soft and sweet. Add the peppers and garlic and cook for another 10 minutes, stirring now and then.

steps.sk: Pridaj cuketu a opekaj 8 minút, potom vmiešaj paradajky, cukor, soľ a korenie a var bez pokrievky 15 minút, kým sa šťava neodparí a pisto nie je husté ako omáčka na cestoviny.
steps.en: Add the courgettes and cook for 8 minutes, then stir in the tomatoes, sugar, salt and pepper and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes until the liquid has evaporated and the pisto is as thick as a pasta sauce.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji vypráž volské oká na strednom ohni 3 minúty, kým bielok stuhne a okraje sú chrumkavé, ale žĺtok zostane tekutý.
steps.en: Fry the eggs in the remaining oil over a medium heat for 3 minutes until the whites set and the edges crisp, while the yolks stay runny.

steps.sk: Pisto rozdeľ do tanierov, na každý polož vajce a podávaj s chlebom. Samotné pisto vydrží v chladničke 4 dni, chutí aj studené a hodí sa aj ako omáčka na cestoviny.
steps.en: Divide the pisto between plates, top each with an egg and serve with bread. The pisto on its own keeps in the fridge for 4 days, is good cold and also works as a pasta sauce.

title.sk: Lentejas – španielska šošovica s chorizom
title.en: Lentejas: Spanish lentil stew with chorizo

description.sk: Hustá šošovica so zemiakmi, zeleninou a údenou klobásou chorizo – španielske domáce jedlo.
description.en: A thick stew of lentils, potatoes, vegetables and smoky chorizo; Spanish home cooking.

steps.sk: Šošovicu prepláchni. Cibuľu, papriku a paradajku nakrájaj nadrobno, mrkvu na kolieska, zemiaky na kocky s hranou 2 cm a chorizo na plátky hrubé 5 mm.
steps.en: Rinse the lentils. Finely chop the onion, pepper and tomato, slice the carrots, cut the potatoes into 2 cm cubes and the chorizo into 5 mm slices.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozohrej olej a chorizo na ňom opekaj 2 minúty, kým nepustí oranžový tuk. Pridaj cibuľu, papriku a cesnak a opekaj 5 minút, potom pridaj paradajku a údenú papriku a miešaj ešte minútu.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pot and fry the chorizo for 2 minutes until it releases its orange fat. Add the onion, pepper and garlic and fry for 5 minutes, then add the tomato and smoked paprika and stir for another minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj šošovicu, mrkvu, bobkové listy a 1,2 litra vody, priveď do varu a var prikryté na miernom ohni 20 minút.
steps.en: Add the lentils, carrots, bay leaves and 1.2 litres of water, bring to the boil and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj zemiaky a soľ a var ďalších 15 až 20 minút, kým šošovica aj zemiaky nie sú mäkké a jedlo zhustne. Ak je príliš husté, prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Add the potatoes and salt and simmer for another 15 to 20 minutes until the lentils and potatoes are soft and the stew has thickened. If it is too thick, add a splash of water.

steps.sk: Nechaj 5 minút odpočinúť a podávaj s chlebom. Lentejas sa v Španielsku varia dopredu: v chladničke vydržia 4 dni a dajú sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Let it rest for 5 minutes and serve with bread. In Spain lentejas are made ahead: they keep in the fridge for 4 days and freeze well.

title.sk: Kuracie stehná na cesnaku a víne (pollo al ajillo)
title.en: Pollo al ajillo: garlic chicken with white wine

description.sk: Kúsky kuracích stehien opečené na olivovom oleji s celými strúčikmi cesnaku, vínom a tymianom.
description.en: Chicken thigh pieces fried in olive oil with whole garlic cloves, white wine and thyme.

steps.sk: Stehná nakrájaj na kusy veľké ako sústo (asi 3 cm), posoľ a okoreň. Cesnak ošúp a strúčiky len zľahka roztlač plochou nožom – celé strúčiky budú sladké a mäkké, nie štipľavé.
steps.en: Cut the thighs into bite-sized pieces of about 3 cm and season with the salt and pepper. Peel the garlic and lightly crush the cloves with the flat of a knife; whole cloves turn sweet and soft rather than sharp.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici rozohrej olej na miernom ohni, pridaj cesnak a pomaly ho opekaj 4 minúty, kým nie je svetlozlatý. Vyber ho, aby nezhorkol.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide frying pan over a low heat, add the garlic and fry it slowly for 4 minutes until pale gold. Lift it out before it turns bitter.

steps.sk: Zvýš oheň a na cesnakovom oleji opeč mäso 8 až 10 minút za občasného obracania, kým nie je zo všetkých strán zlatohnedé.
steps.en: Turn up the heat and fry the chicken in the garlic oil for 8 to 10 minutes, turning now and then, until golden brown on all sides.

steps.sk: Vráť cesnak, pridaj bobkové listy, tymian a čili, prilej víno a nechaj ho 1 minútu povrieť. Prikry a var na miernom ohni 10 minút, potom odkry a var ešte 3 minúty, kým šťava nezhustne. Mäso je hotové pri 74 °C, šťava z neho je číra.
steps.en: Return the garlic, add the bay leaves, thyme and chilli, pour in the wine and let it bubble for 1 minute. Cover and simmer gently for 10 minutes, then uncover and cook for 3 minutes more until the juices thicken. The chicken is done at 74 °C, with clear juices.

steps.sk: Posyp nasekanou petržlenovou vňaťou a podávaj s chlebom, ktorým vytrieš cesnakovú šťavu, alebo so šalátom. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Scatter with chopped parsley and serve with bread to mop up the garlicky juices, or with a salad. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Treska v zelenej petržlenovej omáčke
title.en: Merluza en salsa verde: cod in parsley sauce

description.sk: Baskická klasika: biela ryba dusená v omáčke z olivového oleja, cesnaku, vína a petržlenovej vňate.
description.en: A Basque classic: white fish poached in a sauce of olive oil, garlic, wine and parsley.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na hrubé kolieska a var v osolenej vode (¼ lyžičky soli) 15 minút do mäkka. Vajcia var 9 minút natvrdo, ošúp a nakrájaj na štvrtiny. Rybu osuš a posoľ zvyšnou soľou.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, cut them into thick slices and boil them in salted water (¼ teaspoon of salt) for 15 minutes until tender. Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and quarter them. Pat the fish dry and season it with the remaining salt.

steps.sk: Cesnak nakrájaj nadrobno a petržlenovú vňať nasekaj aj s tenkými stonkami. V širokej panvici rozohrej olej na miernom ohni a cesnak v ňom opekaj 1 minútu, kým nezavonia; nesmie zhnednúť.
steps.en: Chop the garlic finely and the parsley, thin stalks and all. Warm the oil in a wide frying pan over a low heat and cook the garlic for 1 minute until fragrant; it must not brown.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj múku a miešaj 30 sekúnd, potom prilej víno a 150 ml vody a za stáleho miešania var 2 minúty, kým omáčka nezhustne. Vmiešaj väčšinu petržlenovej vňate a hrášok.
steps.en: Stir in the flour for 30 seconds, then pour in the wine and 150 ml water and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring, until the sauce thickens. Stir in most of the parsley and the peas.

steps.sk: Do omáčky polož rybu kožou nahor a var na miernom ohni 4 minúty, potom ju otoč a var ďalšie 2 až 3 minúty. Panvicou počas varu jemne krúž, želatína z ryby omáčku zahustí. Ryba je hotová, keď sa ľahko oddeľuje na lupienky.
steps.en: Lay the fish in the sauce skin side up and simmer gently for 4 minutes, then turn it and cook for 2 to 3 minutes more. Gently swirl the pan as it cooks; the gelatine from the fish thickens the sauce. The fish is done when it flakes easily.

steps.sk: Pridaj do panvice zemiaky a vajcia, posyp zvyšnou vňaťou a podávaj priamo z panvice. Ryba je najlepšia hneď po uvarení.
steps.en: Add the potatoes and eggs to the pan, scatter with the remaining parsley and serve straight from the pan. The fish is best eaten as soon as it is cooked.

title.sk: Vajcia po flamencky s chorizom a hráškom
title.en: Huevos a la flamenca: baked eggs with chorizo and peas

description.sk: Vajcia zapečené v paradajkovej omáčke s chorizom, šunkou, paprikou a hráškom.
description.en: Eggs baked in tomato sauce with chorizo, ham, peppers and peas.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Cibuľu a papriku nakrájaj na drobné kocky, cesnak nadrobno, chorizo na plátky a šunku na prúžky.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Dice the onion and pepper small, chop the garlic finely, slice the chorizo and cut the ham into strips.

steps.sk: V panvici vhodnej do rúry rozohrej olej, opeč chorizo 2 minúty a polovicu vyber na ozdobu. Pridaj cibuľu, papriku a cesnak a opekaj 6 minút do mäkka.
steps.en: Heat the oil in an ovenproof frying pan, fry the chorizo for 2 minutes and set half aside for the top. Add the onion, pepper and garlic and cook for 6 minutes until soft.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj údenú papriku, paradajky a soľ a var 10 minút do hustej omáčky, potom pridaj hrášok a šunku. Lyžicou urob v omáčke 4 jamky, do každej rozbi vajce a navrch rozlož zvyšné chorizo.
steps.en: Stir in the smoked paprika, tomatoes and salt and simmer for 10 minutes into a thick sauce, then add the peas and ham. Make 4 hollows in the sauce with a spoon, crack an egg into each and scatter over the reserved chorizo.

steps.sk: Panvicu vlož do rúry a peč 8 až 10 minút, kým bielky stuhnú a žĺtky sú ešte mäkké. Bielok okolo žĺtka už nesmie byť priesvitný.
steps.en: Put the pan in the oven and bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still soft. The white around the yolk should no longer be translucent.

steps.sk: Posyp petržlenovou vňaťou a podávaj priamo v panvici s chlebom na namáčanie. Omáčku môžeš pripraviť deň vopred a vajcia zapiecť až pred jedlom.
steps.en: Scatter with parsley and serve in the pan with bread for dipping. You can make the sauce a day ahead and bake the eggs just before eating.

title.sk: Arroz al horno – pečená ryža s mäsom a cícerom
title.en: Arroz al horno: Valencian baked rice with pork and chickpeas

description.sk: Valencijská ryža pečená v rúre s bravčovým, klobásou, cícerom, zemiakmi a paradajkami.
description.en: Valencian rice baked in the oven with pork, sausage, chickpeas, potatoes and tomatoes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Mäso nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 3 cm, klobásu na hrubé kúsky, zemiaky na kolieska hrubé 1 cm a jednu paradajku na plátky. Druhú paradajku nastrúhaj a šupku vyhoď. Cícer sceď.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the pork into 3 cm cubes, the sausage into thick chunks, the potatoes into 1 cm slices and one tomato into slices. Grate the other tomato and discard the skin. Drain the chickpeas.

steps.sk: V hrnci priveď do varu 750 ml vody s bujónom a nechaj ho na najmenšom ohni. V širokej panvici rozohrej olej, opeč na ňom zemiaky 3 minúty z každej strany a vyber ich. Potom opeč mäso a klobásu 6 minút dohneda.
steps.en: Bring 750 ml water with the stock cube to the boil and keep it on the lowest heat. Heat the oil in a wide frying pan, fry the potatoes for 3 minutes on each side and lift them out. Then brown the pork and sausage for 6 minutes.

steps.sk: K mäsu pridaj ošúpané strúčiky cesnaku, nastrúhanú paradajku, papriku a kurkumu a miešaj 2 minúty. Vsyp ryžu a cícer, minútu ich premiešavaj, aby sa ryža obalila olejom, osoľ a všetko prelož do zapekacej misy.
steps.en: Add the peeled garlic cloves, grated tomato, paprika and turmeric to the meat and stir for 2 minutes. Add the rice and chickpeas and stir for a minute to coat the rice in oil, season with the salt and transfer everything to a baking dish.

steps.sk: Ryžu rovnomerne rozlož, navrch poukladaj zemiaky a plátky paradajky a zalej horúcim vývarom. Peč 25 až 30 minút bez miešania, kým ryža nevsiakne všetok vývar a povrch nie je opečený.
steps.en: Spread the rice out evenly, arrange the potatoes and tomato slices on top and pour over the hot stock. Bake without stirring for 25 to 30 minutes until the rice has absorbed all the stock and the top is browned.

steps.sk: Nechaj ju 5 minút odpočinúť prikrytú utierkou. Ryža má byť mäkká, ale sypká, zemiaky zlatisté a mäso má mať vnútri aspoň 70 °C. Zvyšky vydržia v chladničke 3 dni a prehreješ ich s lyžicou vody.
steps.en: Let it rest for 5 minutes under a tea towel. The rice should be tender but separate, the potatoes golden and the pork at least 70 °C inside. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 3 days and reheat with a spoonful of water.
